title: Mobile dashboard controls stay within reach
summary:
A day of small repairs: reachable mobile account controls, intact docs links, and a clearer pointer to MCP documentation.

The mobile drawer now keeps its logo and account controls pinned while navigation and other links scroll. A shared scroll component also makes scrolling more consistent across dashboard content, dropdowns, and dialogs.

The `/api/docs` redirect now carries query parameters through to `/docs`, including `?format=json`. Related test maintenance removes a date-dependent account-usage check.

The README’s Latest News section now links to the MCP server docs and notes that local AI agents can connect through it.
